originAndSelection.meaning: Width is the Gaussian denominator parameter, not full visible groove width. The 5-11 micrometre coefficient is not final depth: branch overlap, along envelope, width/filterWidth, global visibility, edge envelope, foldStrength, strain, wetness and material mask act afterwards. Cell spacing is not exact adjacent-groove spacing because roots jitter.
originAndSelection.documentedReason: Original source explicitly calls spacing and heights engineering initial values. R01 research/README discuss pixel filtering and avoiding regular deep grooves. R03 implementation review calls the same Gaussian/filter/visibility values inherited. No quantitative derivation or tuning sweep for these exact thresholds was located in the reviewed committed records.
originAndSelection.notSupported: The reviewed history does not support saying these values were selected after a stronger/wider fine-normal candidate failed. They were unchanged from first committed introduction.
